client_cert.description: secret_ref to a PEM-encoded client certificate, resolved by the core before the adapter is spawned. Optional — only needed when the target systemd-journal-gatewayd instance is configured with mTLS (--trust). Omit for plain HTTP/HTTPS access.

client_key.description: secret_ref to the PEM-encoded private key matching client_cert. Required together with client_cert, omitted together.

unit.description: Restrict to one systemd unit name (matched against _SYSTEMD_UNIT); empty string (default) means all units.

min_priority.description: Minimum syslog priority to report (0=emerg .. 7=debug, lower is more severe). Entries with a higher (less severe) PRIORITY are dropped.

lookback_seconds.description: How far back each poll looks for journal entries, applied client-side against the last 2000 fetched entries.
